pairs.subject: job-coordination
pairs.evidence: app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:177 A resume after a `raise_failed` receipt (sourcing already finished, only the alert raise failed) calls runGoLive in `resume` mode. That mode changes only the response flags, so the run starts again from the sourcing step, re-spawns the sourcing child, and ignores the step position the receipt already recorded.

techniques.evidence: app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:177 The receipt separates sourcing_failed from raise_failed, but app/_lib/golive-run.ts reads `mode` only for `alreadyPublished`/`resumed` in its result. Recovery restarts from step 1 instead of the first incomplete step. Sourcing is dedup-safe (createPipelineEntry returns `created`), so the cost is a repeated sourcing spawn, not duplicate entries.

app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:161 The durable `sourcing` receipt is written inside the go-live transaction, before runGoLive dispatches anything. The record therefore tells 'dispatched, outcome unknown' apart from both done and the failure verdicts.

app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:128 The billing gate, status flip, terms write, meter debit and receipt open run as one synchronous transaction with no await inside. A debit can never be separated from its flip (repair 1/2: collapse the span into one atomic effect).

app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:159 The role's review terms (target hires, posting languages) are written into the record in the same act as the flip. Cancellation stays live: request.signal is passed to runGoLive.

app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:21 maxDuration is documented as binding nothing on self-host. runGoLive takes a cancellation signal and an attempt but no deadline, and the real bound is the per-child timeout of the process the code owns.

app/api/jobs/[id]/publish/route.ts:171 The go-live hold is minutes, bounded by per-child timeouts, not hours. Reclaim is the claim-timestamp heuristic (GOLIVE_RESUME_GRACE_MS = 10 min, in the out-of-context golive-receipt-store.ts), which the technique allows for short work. Stale writers are fenced by finishReceipt's CAS on `attempt`.
